questions.question: Please identify the page in Nancy Marie Brown’s The Abacus and the Cross for the line about a magician, a king and a mathematician. The publisher confirms the 2012 edition at https://www.hachettebookgroup.com/titles/nancy-marie-brown/the-abacus-and-the-cross/9780465031443/, but the exact line has not yet been checked against the book.
